user.title: Add a sourdough starter
user.description: Required: starter name, storage location, and bench and fridge feed frequencies. Last fed is optional and can be recorded later with Fed now. All reminder integrations and external Home Assistant entities are optional; leave targets empty and optional features disabled for schedule-only tracking.

data.name: Starter name
data.occupancy_audio_only: Only speak while the household is occupied
data.disruptive_max_count: Maximum disruptive reminders per feed cycle
data.disruptive_max_overdue_hours: Stop disruptive reminders after hours due

data_description.last_fed: Optional. Leave empty if the starter has not been fed yet.
data_description.bench_interval_hours: Hours between feeds while stored on the bench. Default: 48.
data_description.fridge_interval_hours: Hours between feeds while refrigerated. Default: 168.
data_description.preferred_time_enabled: Align interval-based feeding times to a consistent local clock time.
data_description.bench_preferred_feed_time: The local clock time when a bench feed becomes due.
data_description.fridge_preferred_feed_time: The local clock time when a refrigerated feed becomes due.
data_description.holiday_mode_entity: Optional. Existing binary sensor used to detect Holiday Mode. Leave empty if Holiday Mode should not affect reminders.
data_description.holiday_mode_policy: Choose whether Holiday Mode suppresses push only, suppresses all reminders, or is ignored.
data_description.due_soon_hours: How many hours before feeding is due the first reminder is sent. Use 0 to disable the early reminder.
data_description.notification_targets: Optional. Choose one or more notification entities for push reminders. Leave empty for no push delivery.
data_description.overdue_interval_minutes: Minutes between reminders after feeding becomes due. Minimum: 5.
data_description.quiet_hours_enabled: Suppress scheduled reminders during the configured overnight period.
data_description.quiet_start: No scheduled reminders are sent from this time.
data_description.quiet_end: Scheduled reminders resume at this time.
data_description.confirm_feed: Send a confirmation to the same targets whenever a feed is recorded.
data_description.audio_enabled: Speak feeding reminders through Home Assistant media players.
data_description.occupancy_audio_only: When enabled, audio is spoken only while the configured household sensor is on.
data_description.occupancy_entity: Optional. Binary sensor that indicates somebody is home. Used only when occupancy-aware audio is enabled. Default: binary_sensor.house_occupied.
data_description.audio_tts_entity: Optional. Select the voice or text-to-speech provider used when audio reminders are enabled.
data_description.audio_targets: Optional. Select one or more media players for audio reminders. Unavailable players are skipped.
data_description.audio_lead_time_hours: Hours before feeding is due to begin spoken reminders. Use 0 to begin when due.
data_description.audio_interval_minutes: Minutes between spoken reminders. Audio also respects quiet hours and snooze.
data_description.audio_volume_percent: Temporary volume used for spoken reminders. The previous player volume is restored after the announcement.
data_description.disruptive_max_count: Maximum audio/light reminder cycles before they stop until the next feed. Use 0 for unlimited.
data_description.disruptive_max_overdue_hours: Stop audio and light reminders this many hours after feeding becomes due. Push continues. Use 0 for unlimited.
data_description.light_targets: Optional. Select colour-capable lights to flash whenever a push or audio feeding reminder is sent. Leave empty for no light alerts.
data_description.light_color: Choose the reminder flash colour. The default is red.
data_description.light_flash_count: Number of colour pulses in each light reminder. Default: 3.
data_description.light_pulse_seconds: Seconds the reminder colour remains visible for each pulse. Default: 1.
data_description.light_gap_seconds: Seconds spent at the original colour or off between pulses. Default: 0.25.

init.title: Feeding reminders
init.description: Core scheduling only needs the bench and fridge feed frequencies. Preferred times, Holiday Mode, push, quiet hours, audio, occupancy and light reminders are optional. Leave target selectors empty and keep optional features disabled when they are not required.
